existing_engine_coverage.verdict: 10 critical engines absent; existing MultiControllerCalibrationEngine is controller-protocol calibration (encoder counts, axis kinematics) NOT physics-constant fit

training_targets.data_source: Spindle power meter (kW) via MTConnect/FOCAS/THINC during test cuts on stock from each unique supplier-material lot. JM Die: assume 6-12 distinct supplier-material combinations across 21 machines (e.g. 4140 from Supplier-X, 1018 from Supplier-Y, 304SS from Supplier-Z).
training_targets.cadence: one-shot at onboarding + on-trigger when new supplier or new material lot introduced (>5% deviation from baseline triggers re-fit)
training_targets.fit_method: Linear regression in log-log space: ln(Fc) = ln(kc1.1) + (1-mc)*ln(h). Sample 8 test cuts per material at varying chip thickness h ∈ [0.05, 0.4] mm. Solve via least-squares with weighted residuals (1/sigma_F^2). Confidence interval via bootstrap n=500. Per-shop offset = kc_measured / kc_baseline (multiplicative correction).
training_targets.validation_gate: R² > 0.92 on holdout fold + bootstrap CI half-width < 8% of mean kc1.1 + Bayesian prior penalty if measured kc deviates >30% from ISO-group baseline (likely sensor drift)
training_targets.fallback: If <3 valid test cuts: use ISO-group baseline from constants.ts and emit telemetry event 'kienzle.fallback.baseline_only' with confidence_tier='envelope-not-fit'. Stack with Round3 agent5 conformal 12% safety margin.

training_targets.data_source: Tool-life log per machine: (cutting speed Vc, time-to-failure T, criterion=Vb=0.3mm or chip-color shift). JM Die: 21 machines × 6 tool-classes (carbide-uncoated, carbide-TiAlN, carbide-AlTiN, ceramic, CBN, HSS) = 126 (machine, tool-class) tuples. Need ≥5 data points per tuple = 630 tool-life trials minimum for full coverage; achievable via 6-month operator-log accumulation.
training_targets.cadence: continuous accumulation; weekly regression refit when ≥1 new data point per (machine, tool-class); monthly cross-validation report
training_targets.fit_method: Log-linear regression: ln(T) = ln(C) - (1/n)*ln(Vc). C and n per (machine, tool-class). Hierarchical Bayesian prior centered on constants.ts canonical values to avoid overfit when corpus thin. Posterior shrinkage toward prior weighted by sample count.
training_targets.validation_gate: Posterior CI on n must exclude n=0 (degenerate) and n>0.6 (unphysical for non-HSS). R² > 0.80 (lower than Kienzle — tool-life is high-variance). Cross-validate against held-out 20% of trials.
training_targets.fallback: Per-machine override absent → use shop-average C/n; shop-average absent → ISO-group baseline from constants.ts. Emit confidence tier 'envelope|shop-avg|machine-specific' in every Gilbert speed call.

training_targets.data_source: Hammer-impulse FRF (accelerometer + impact hammer) measured at tool tip with toolholder loaded. JM Die: 21 machines × est. 8 dominant toolholder stacks each = 168 FRF measurements. RCSA (Receptance Coupling Substructure Analysis) predicts FRF for new tool/holder combinations from base machine+holder FRF.
training_targets.cadence: one-shot at shop install (full FRF sweep — 1 measurement day per machine) + on-trigger after major spindle service/bearing replacement + monthly spot-check (3-stack subset, drift < 15% expected modal frequency shift)
training_targets.fit_method: FFT of impact response → FRF magnitude/phase. Modal extraction via rational fraction polynomial. Altintas-Budak stability solver computes Re[Λ(ω)] eigenvalues → lobe boundaries. RCSA per Schmitz Section 4 for tool-stack extrapolation. Output: 2D map (spindle RPM, axial depth ap) with stability_score ∈ [0,1].
training_targets.validation_gate: Predicted chatter onset RPM within ±8% of cut-test verification (3 verification cuts per machine post-FRF). Mode count ≥3 within 0-4000Hz band (else FRF is noise-dominated).
training_targets.fallback: Without FRF: use machine-class default SLD from MachineToolEnvelopeEngine (conservative envelope — chatter-likely-region marked at 70% of free-vibration limits). Telemetry tier 'sld-class-default' (vs 'sld-machine-measured').

training_targets.data_source: Thermal-warmup probe routine: touch-probe Z-touch at known artifact every 5 min for 2-hour warmup cycle, cold-start to thermal-equilibrium. Record axis position drift vs time + spindle temp + ambient temp. 21 machines × 4-5 axes = ~90 (machine,axis) thermal curves.
training_targets.cadence: one-shot at onboarding (2-hour cycle per machine) + monthly re-verification (single 30-min spot-check) + on-trigger after coolant chiller service or seasonal ambient temp shift (>10°C)
training_targets.fit_method: First-order linear thermal model: Δposition(t,T_spindle) = α_axis * (T_spindle - T_ref) + β_axis * (T_ambient - T_ref_amb). Solve α, β via OLS. Compensate via G10 L20 work-offset update in real-time (TouchPoint-style).
training_targets.validation_gate: RMSE on thermal-cycle residuals < 5μm (tight tolerance shop) or < 15μm (general). α magnitude physically plausible (1-3 μm/°C for cast-iron column, 5-12 μm/°C for spindle).
training_targets.fallback: Without thermal model: assume worst-case 25μm axial drift over 2h warmup, add to tolerance stack budget. Block tight-tol (IT5/IT6) parts until thermal-fit complete.

training_targets.data_source: Predicted-vs-actual log per (operation, machine, material, tool). Predicted = SFC physics output; actual = post-op measurement (spindle peak load %, surface finish, dimensional check). Stream via MTConnect part-program completion event.
training_targets.cadence: continuous (every completed op logged) + on-trigger recalibration when rolling-window deviation exceeds threshold
training_targets.fit_method: Adaptive Conformal Prediction (APS / Romano 2020 — already shipped via AdaptiveConformalAlphaEngine commit 03586e2fa). Drift detector: CUSUM on |predicted - actual| / sigma_predicted. Trigger: cumulative deviation > 3σ over 50-sample window OR 5-sample run all >1σ same direction.
training_targets.validation_gate: Empirical coverage ≥ 1-α (target 90% within prediction interval). Brier score < 0.15 for binary outcomes (chatter/no-chatter, broken/intact).
training_targets.fallback: On drift detected: widen conformal interval (alpha 0.10 → 0.15), block dispatcher action until 20-sample post-drift recalibration window completes, emit operator alert.

training_targets.data_source: JM Die archive .NC/.PRG/.MIN mill programs (~8K filtered) — each program = (material header, tool table, operation block) → (S/F chosen, ap/ae chosen, strategy choice) supervision pair. Augment via SpeedFeedOrchestrator physics-oracle synthetic sweep (1000 material×tool combos). MTConnect public dumps (~2K supplementary). Outcome-bridge reward signal from XPROC-NEURAL-CONNECT replay (commit 3b21228f7).
training_targets.cadence: at-onboarding initial train (8-12 hour single-GPU job on A100 or equivalent) + monthly fine-tune incremental (1-2 hour on accumulated new programs)
training_targets.fit_method: QLoRA r=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.1, attention layers only (q_proj, v_proj). 3 epochs, learning rate 2e-4, cosine schedule. Loss: cross-entropy on token-level S/F/strategy outputs + KL-penalty against base model (prevent catastrophic forgetting).
training_targets.validation_gate: Held-out 10% test set: token-level accuracy on S/F prediction > 75% (within ±5% tolerance band), strategy classification F1 > 0.82. Compare against base-model-no-adapter baseline — adapter must show >8% absolute lift.
training_targets.fallback: lora-weights-presence-check.mjs hook (proposed Round3 agent9) blocks dispatcher action when adapter missing. Inference returns {adapter_loaded: false, fallback_reason}. Routes to base qwen2.5-coder:7b unfine-tuned + telemetry event 'lora.fallback.weights_missing'.

training_targets.data_source: JM Die Mazak/Okuma .MIN files with '$<INTERNAL>%' line-1 header (per reference_jm_die_program_save_practice memory — ~3-5K canonical lathe corpus). LatheLoRADatasetBuilderEngine already exists.
training_targets.fit_method: QLoRA r=8, alpha=16, same schedule as mill_lora. Narrower task surface (turning + threading + grooving + chip-control).
training_targets.validation_gate: Chip-control regime classification F1 > 0.85 (favorable/unfavorable/unacceptable per ISO 3685). S/F prediction accuracy > 75%.
training_targets.fallback: Same as mill_lora — telemetry fallback to base model.

training_targets.data_source: 26 JM Die WEDM programs + 46 WEDM tribal tips + 14 WEDM formulas with MIT citations. Synthetic pulse-energy sweeps across 5 controller dialects.
training_targets.cadence: at-onboarding only initially (corpus too thin for monthly refit); quarterly refit once corpus > 100 programs
training_targets.fit_method: QLoRA r=4, alpha=8 (rank-4 minimizes overfit risk on small corpus — aligns with LoRA-FA low-shot findings).
training_targets.validation_gate: Cycle-time prediction MAPE < 15% on held-out 5-program test set. Surface-finish Ra prediction within ±0.4μm.
training_targets.fallback: Defer to physics-only WEDMOrchestrator + tribal-tip retrieval.

training_targets.node: cam_lora ensemble (operation_classify + strategy_recommend + tool_select, each rank-8)
training_targets.data_source: Mastercam (45 extracted ops) + hyperMILL (25 extracted ops) operations + post-processor CPS files. CamStrategyEngine recommendations as weak supervision.
training_targets.fit_method: Per-task adapters, ensemble at inference via Bayesian model averaging weighted by per-task held-out accuracy.
training_targets.validation_gate: Operation classification top-1 accuracy > 0.88; strategy recommendation top-3 recall > 0.90; tool selection within Mastercam tool-library top-5 > 0.85.

training_targets.data_source: Operator notes via shop-floor UI text input + voice-to-text (Whisper local, already capable via @xenova/transformers). Triggered post-op when operator overrode CAM defaults or noted unusual outcome.
training_targets.cadence: continuous; nightly batch ingestion into wiki/code-tribal/ + embedding into Qdrant 'prism_kg_nodes' collection
training_targets.fit_method: No model fit per se — embedding-only. Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 384-dim embeddings. Tag extraction via Ollama qwen2.5-coder:7b zero-shot (domain/machine/material/tool tags). Promote high-citation tips to playbook rules (≥3 references across operators).
training_targets.validation_gate: Tip quality lint via /wiki-lint (existing skill). Anti-duplicate via embedding cosine similarity > 0.85 → flag for merge. False-positive rate on tag extraction < 10% (sample human-audit monthly).
training_targets.fallback: Manual operator-form fallback (no Whisper) — text-only capture still feeds wiki.

sensors_needed: Spindle power meter (kW) — primary channel for Kienzle fit; native on Mazak Smooth/Okuma OSP/Haas NGC, retrofit clamp-on CT for older Fanuc
Impact hammer (PCB 086C03 or equivalent) + tri-axial accelerometer (PCB 356A16) — FRF measurement at tool tip
Touch probe (Renishaw OMP60 or equivalent) — thermal growth probe routine + workpiece alignment
Spindle temperature thermocouple (most controllers have internal; expose via FOCAS/THINC parameter)
Ambient temperature sensor (DS18B20 1-wire on machine column — $5 retrofit per machine)
Operator UI for tribal-knowledge capture (existing web frontend mcp-server/web/) + microphone for Whisper voice-to-text
Tool-life logger (operator-driven via shop-floor UI when chip-color shift / dimensional drift triggers tool change)
protocols: MTConnect (preferred — Mazak Smooth, Haas NGC, modern controllers)
telemetry_pipeline.ingestion_engine: new TelemetryIngestionOrchestratorEngine — consolidates 5 protocol adapters into unified event stream → Qdrant (vector) + DuckDB (time-series) + Stop-hook calibration triggers. Wire to prism_intelligence:telemetry_ingest + prism_session:sensor_status_poll. Existing MTConnectRoundTripLatencyBenchEngine measures one protocol's RTT; this new engine is the ingestion fabric.

data_gaps: JM Die spindle power telemetry not currently logged — first-day onboarding must install MTConnect agents + verify kW channel on all 21 machines BEFORE Kienzle fit can run. Risk: 2-3 machines may be too old for native MTConnect, requiring clamp-on CT retrofit (~$400/machine, ~1 day install).

Tool-life log nonexistent — currently NO machine logs (Vc, T_failure) trials. Taylor C/n fit requires ≥5 data points per (machine, tool-class) tuple = 630 trials for full coverage at JM Die. Cold-start 6-month accumulation period; in interim rely on ISO baseline + shop-average shrinkage. RISK: Gilbert economic speed formula (Round3 agent5) operates on baseline-only for first 6 months, losing 60-70% of value.

FRF measurement requires shop floor downtime + skilled technician — JM Die may not have either in-house. Onboarding-day 4.5h sweep is critical-path and customer must commit. Without FRF, SLD falls back to class-default conservative envelope which leaves 20-30% productivity on the table.
summary.verdict: SFC requires 10 new calibration engines + a unified telemetry-ingestion fabric. The onboarding day is feasible in 10 hours if pre-flight (MTConnect agents) is completed week-prior. The monthly maintenance cadence is 4-6 automated tasks/month + 2h operator overhead. Critical-path data gaps: spindle power telemetry availability, tool-life log cold-start, FRF measurement downtime commitment. Without these three, SFC degrades to envelope-only physics with 12% conformal margin — still ships, but the per-shop fit value-add (which justifies the premium SaaS tier) is unrealized.
summary.one_line: SFC training = 11 nodes (4 physics-fit + 1 SLD + 1 conformal + 4 LoRA + 1 tribal) + 10 new engines; onboarding-day is a 10-hour shop visit ending with overnight LoRA train; monthly maintenance ~2h operator + 4-6 automated jobs; top data gaps are spindle-power telemetry, tool-life log cold-start, and FRF measurement downtime.
